arrivalEssentials: Check that your flight and pickup both say Dabolim (GOI). Goa also has Manohar International Airport at Mopa (GOX), a different airport.
Have your approved Indian visa or eVisa ready before departure; complete the e-Arrival Card within 72 hours before arrival if applicable.
Book your transfer to the exact hotel and village. Panaji, North Goa and South Goa need different journeys from GOI.
Keep INR, a working data connection and your hotel address handy; use sealed bottled or trusted filtered drinking water.

entryRequirements.passportValidity: Your passport should have at least 6 months validity remaining and enough blank pages for entry stamps.
entryRequirements.visaSummary: Australian travellers generally need a valid visa or eVisa before arrival unless they hold another status such as OCI; confirm the right category for tourism, business, or conference travel.
entryRequirements.arrivalCardOrDeclaration: Foreign nationals and OCI card holders can submit India’s e-Arrival Card online within 72 hours before arrival. It is separate from a visa; check the official portal for current requirements.
entryRequirements.officialSourceNote: Check the official Indian Visa Online portal and current Australian Smartraveller advice for India shortly before travel.
importantNotes: Use only the official government visa portal and avoid third-party sites that add high service fees.
Processing times and eligible visa categories vary, so do not leave applications to the last minute.

businessEtiquette.summary: For meetings in Goa, confirm the venue and village, allow for road travel, and keep the same professional courtesy you would bring elsewhere in India.
tips: Confirm whether the meeting is in Panaji, a North Goa venue or a South Goa resort before planning transfers.
Allow extra travel time for traffic and heavy rain; avoid scheduling a tight meeting immediately after landing at GOI.
Dress for the meeting rather than the beach, and begin with a courteous introduction.
Confirm decisions and next steps clearly in writing after meetings.
Build time for conversation and rapport rather than treating every meeting as purely transactional.

foodAndPracticalities.tapWater: Use bottled, filtered, or otherwise trusted water rather than drinking tap water as a visitor.
foodAndPracticalities.tipping: Tipping is common in hotels and many restaurants, especially when a service charge is not already included.
foodAndPracticalities.dietaryNotes: Goan menus often feature seafood and coconut. Ask about fish, shellfish, meat and dairy even when a dish looks vegetable-based; vegetarian choices are available.
foodAndPracticalities.commonFoodTips: Try fish curry and rice, chicken cafreal or bebinca. Choose busy kitchens, ask about spice levels and confirm ingredients if you have allergies.

moneyAndPayments.conversion: Check the live AUD/INR rate before travel and compare your card’s foreign-exchange fees.
moneyAndPayments.cardAcceptance: Cards are useful at hotels and established restaurants. Carry INR for smaller cafés, beach vendors and transport; confirm payment methods before ordering or travelling.
moneyAndPayments.cashNotes: Keep small notes for tips, local shops, markets, and backup transport.
moneyAndPayments.tipping: Often expected in service settings unless a clear service charge is already included.

arrivalGuide.scope: Goa International Airport, Dabolim (GOI) · not Mopa (GOX)
steps: After collecting baggage and clearing customs, look for the prepaid taxi counter in the arrivals area. Give the exact hotel and locality before paying.
Keep the booking receipt and confirm the assigned car and pickup point at the counter. Goa’s beach areas are spread out, so check the destination carefully.
For a hotel transfer, confirm that the driver is meeting you at Dabolim (GOI), and use the meeting point supplied by the hotel.

lateArrival.serviceWindow: A verified last airport-bus departure is not included in this brief. For an evening or delayed flight, arrange a car rather than relying on a bus connection.
lateArrival.fallback: Prebook a hotel transfer with your flight number and a delay contact. If plans change, ask the arrivals prepaid taxi counter for an available car and confirmed fare.
lateArrival.costNote: Confirm any late-night charge, waiting time and the full fare to your beach or town when booking.

quickFacts.seasonalWeather: Goa is tropical and warm. The June–September monsoon brings heavy rain; allow extra transfer time and check local beach conditions.
